title: Identity of explicit raw cohomology pullback
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring, $k:W\to S$ a scheme morphism [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $G$ an etale $\Lambda$-module sheaf on $W$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], $q\in\mathbf Z$ and $U\to S$ etale. Use the raw groups and explicit pullbacks of [sbc-lem-higher-image-raw-over-naturality]. For each scheme $A$ over $W$ and each $z\in P_A(U)$, the raw pullback of the identity of $A$ sends $z$ to itself. No additivity or composition assertion is part of this statement, and no limit or finiteness hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 015F (lemma-right-derived-exact-functor), Tag 09Z1 (lemma-relative-colimit), and canonical comparison maps; source of the corresponding step of lem-sbc-higher-image-raw-pullback-functorial

proof.text: Use the unit coherence of [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition] on the source A.hom followed by k and on the coefficient morphism A.hom. By upperStarComp_id_left the five-factor formula becomes the single of e.inv, inverse single comparison, derived identity pullback of z, shift comparison, and shifted single comparison followed by the single of e.hom.

Apply e termwise to complexes and then the termwise identity comparison. Compose after localization with the exact-derived-functor factorization of [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization]. The localization universal property [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] gives the natural transformation from D(F) to the identity. Its compatibility with each integer shift follows from the termwise identity and the shift-compatible factorization. Faithfulness of precomposition with localization reflects this compatibility. Concretely use Localization.full_whiskeringLeft, Localization.natTrans_ext, and cancellation of the localization shift isomorphism.

On the complex concentrated in degree zero, compute the transformation as the single-functor comparison followed by the image of e. Degree zero is e; in all other degrees the maps to the zero object agree. Apply localization and its factorization comparison. Naturality for z and shift compatibility identify the last four factors with s(e_X) followed by z. Cancel the initial s(e_X inverse). The fully faithful inclusion D-plus into D reflects equality, transporting both sides by its shift comparison. This argument includes negative degrees and zero objects.
